title: Flutter Android cleartext HTTP blocked while iOS simulator still loads API
symptoms: Android device/emulator fails HTTP API calls
iOS simulator works with same URL
cause: Modern Android blocks cleartext (non-HTTPS) traffic by default unless explicitly allowed.
solution: Prefer HTTPS everywhere. For local dev only, configure network security config carefully and never ship broad cleartext allowances to production.
workaround: Use adb reverse / localhost HTTPS reverse proxies for device testing.
